identity.title: Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection

leadText:
The Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by in Australia on December 7, 2016 and in New Zealand on December 1, 2016. This DVD set is also referred to as the Pokémon Gold and Silver Collector's Set in promotional material. It contains 18 discs with 157 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7572. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.

A similar DVD set was released in a more slim design as the Pokémon The Series: Gold And Silver The Collection by Shock Entertainment in Australia on November 2, 2021 with the catalogue number KAL5760B. It contains 18 discs with 157 episodes across them combined.

It contains all of the dubbed episodes from Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver. Specifically, it has episodes from The Johto Journeys, Johto League Champions, and Master Quest.
